levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن أبي عثمان
الحسين بن ثوير بن أبي فاختة

notes: the leading «1» is a report number and is left out
«وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is an unnamed group of shaykhs (unnamed kind); «أبي» is the father, a relation (rule 7)
«جَمِيعاً عَنِ» : four co-transmitters meet at الحسين بن عبيد الله, one level
«يَا حُسَيْنُ» is the addressee inside the saying, left out; the Imam is the last link
